final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost * 1.0 / rental_rate) AS a FROM film GROUP BY rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS oa FROM r WHERE a IS NOT NULL), j AS (SELECT r.a AS a, o.oa AS oa FROM r JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE r.a > o.oa) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_rating_avg, AVG(a - oa) AS avg_diff FROM j
